title: Verification Census: Native vs. Emitted Prediction Parity and One-ULP Binary-Search Disagreement
summary: Audited prediction parity between the native evaluator and emitted code across 1,554 evaluated (context, program) pairs and traced all 41 deterministic failures to quantile-binning operators (C41-C45, C47, C49).

data.splits_and_contexts: 1,554 evaluated (context, program) pairs; 253 screen rows and 2,558 clean arena fold checks (C41, C45)
data.parent_clusters: Verification census across harvested evaluation pairs
data.candidate_or_catalog_size: 6,640 catalog programs, of which 1,636 (24.64%) contain a quantile-binning operator (C42); 1,554 evaluated pairs (342 with binning, 1,212 without binning, C42-C43)
data.contamination_controls: Deterministic parity comparison across repeats, attempts, and two hosts (114 observations of the 41 failing pairs, C44)

arms_or_configs: Native evaluator predictions (crates/feat-math/src/gpr.rs) vs. emitted code predictions (crates/feat-math/src/emit_rs.rs, emit_py.rs, emit_cpp.rs, emit_js.rs) across 1,554 evaluated (context, program) pairs
protocol.compute_budget: 1,554 evaluated pairs + 114 repeated observations of the 41 failing pairs across two hosts
protocol.evaluation_metric: Conditional parity failure rate with and without quantile binning (C41-C43) and maximum error on clean rows (C45)

outcome.verdict: ESTABLISHED in claims.json (C41-C45, C47, C49): 41 of 1,554 evaluated pairs (2.6%, covering 40 programs) failed parity deterministically; 100% of the 41 failing pairs contain a quantile-binning operator (41/342 = 12.0% [8.7%, 15.9%]), while 0/1,212 pairs without binning failed (95% upper bound <= 0.25%).
what_worked: 0/1,212 failures on pairs without quantile binning; 253/253 clean screen rows and 2,557/2,558 clean arena fold checks are bit-exact (C43, C45).

Traced the exact mechanism in TECHNICAL_WRITEUP.md §5.5 (and crates/feat-math/src/gpr.rs:68, emit_rs.rs:502): quantile edges are interpolated as s_lo*(1-f) + s_hi*f (`sorted[lo] * (1.0 - frac) + sorted[hi] * frac`), which on a tie plateau (`s_lo == s_hi == a`) can land one ulp below or above `a` (C47: three of nine plateau edges one ulp off), and the native code uses the standard-library partition search whose probe sequence changed in Rust 1.82.0 while all four emitters keep the classic midpoint loop (C49).
what_failed: 41/342 (12.0%) evaluated pairs containing quantile binning disagreed between the native standard-library partition search and the emitters' classic midpoint loop when `s_lo*(1-f) + s_hi*f` produced one-ulp non-monotone plateau edges (C42, C47, C49).
non_claims: Does not cover out-of-catalog GP programs where other parity failures occurred (see EXP-008 context 14 and context 18).

next_experiment_implications: Follow the TECHNICAL_WRITEUP.md §5.5 / C149 comparability direction (auditing evaluator quantile semantics and a single pinned search emitted identically under a new evaluator protocol identity) while keeping R5 parity charging active.

Joint 5-gate flywheel_established remained false because R4 Active vs. Passive pairwise accuracy lift (+0.001880 [-0.000696, +0.004405]) was INCONCLUSIVE.
what_worked: Unclamped additive LOPO SoS target calibration (`bt + ctx_offset`) corrected active sub-pool opponent-strength selection bias while preserving exact within-pool pairwise differences (`bt_i - bt_j`).

On both shadow-pool-v2 (teacher-excluded) and shadow-pool-v1 (teacher-included), 4 of 5 flywheel gates passed (`GREATER`), including R0->R4 accumulation lift, active HWM discovery, R4 Active vs. Passive primary B=1 gain, and R4 superiority over `program_prior` and `ridge_program` (`ESTABLISHED_SHADOW`).
what_failed: R4 Active vs. Passive retraining was INCONCLUSIVE on global pairwise accuracy (+0.001880 on v2, +0.001164 on v1) and at larger evaluation budgets B=4 and B=8, so the strict joint 5-gate `flywheel_established` boolean remained false.

Standalone full-pool evaluation (`jope_pools evaluate`) achieved `ESTABLISHED_SHADOW` on shadow-pool-v2 at B=1, but remained `NOT_ESTABLISHED` on top-B realized gain against `ridge_program` at B=8 and on shadow-pool-v1.
non_claims: Explicitly disclosed as post-iteration shadow-pool validation across 7 development iterations (`shadow_only = true`, `qualified_claim = false`, `l6_claim = false`), not a single-shot pre-registered confirmatory holdout test.
